name: Question 6
problem:
$10$ is composite **or** even, **and** $8$ is divisible by $2$ **or** $6.$

Express the compound statement above in symbolic form given the following notations:

- $A:10\text{ is composite}$

- $B:10\text{ is even}$

- $C:8\text{ is divisible by }2$

- $D:8\text{ is divisible by }6$
worked_solution:
The word "and" is represented by the symbol "$∧$", while the word "or" is represented by the symbol "$∨$".

Note that this sentence consists of two parts:

- **Part 1:** $10$ is composite or even. This corresponds to

$$
{{10\text{ is composite}}_{⏟}}_{A}\,{{\text{or}}_{⏟}}_{∨}\,{{10\text{ is even }}_{⏟}}_{B}
$$

that is, $A∨B.$

- **Part 2:** $8$ is divisible by $2$ or $6.$ This corresponds to

$$
{{8\text{ is divisible by 2}}_{⏟}}_{C}\,{{\text{or}}_{⏟}}_{∨}\,{{8\text{ is divisible by }6}_{⏟}}_{D},
$$

that is, $C∨D.$

So, we can express the sentence as

$$
{{10\text{ is composite }\text{or}\text{ even}}_{⏟}}_{A\,∨\,B}\,{{\text{and}}_{⏟}}_{∧}\,{{8\text{ is divisible by }2\text{ or }6}_{⏟}}_{C\,∨\,D},
$$

that is, $(A∨B)∧(C∨D).$

html:
Question 6
?

10 is composite or even, and 8 is divisible by 2 or 6.

Express the compound statement above in symbolic form given the following notations:

  • A:10 is composite

  • B:10 is even

  • C:8 is divisible by 2

  • D:8 is divisible by 6

a
(A∨B)∨(C∨D)
b
(A∧B)∧(C∧D)
c
(A∨B)∧(C∨D)
d
(A∧B)∧(C∨D)
e
(A∨B)∧(C∧D)
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The word "and" is represented by the symbol "∧", while the word "or" is represented by the symbol "∨".

Note that this sentence consists of two parts:

  • Part 1: 10 is composite or even. This corresponds to 10p is composite⏟Apor⏟∨10p is even ⏟B that is, A∨B.

  • Part 2: 8 is divisible by 2 or 6. This corresponds to 8p is divisible by 2⏟Cpor⏟∨8p is divisible by 6⏟D, that is, C∨D.

So, we can express the sentence as 10p is composite or even⏟A∨Bpand⏟∧8p is divisible by 2 or 6⏟C∨D,

that is, (A∨B)∧(C∨D).
